previousRule: Style Direction eligibility was sent when the Interior Fabric Brief was confirmed, but omitted from later feedback and refinement commands even though those commands replay the displayed V2 direction state.
newRule: Feedback and refinement for a persisted Style Directions V2 result receive the same server-derived retail eligibility projection used when its cards were rendered; other actions retain their existing projection behaviour.
reason: Without the retained eligibility context, the governed learning input changes between display and reaction and the HCI service rejects the feedback command despite the customer selecting a card that was actually shown.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner explicitly authorised this post-Style-Direction feedback regression fix, limited to the existing eligibility context and state transition, with no changes to selection, ranking, price tiers, Calibration, Fabric Knowledge or taxonomy.
